paper_title: Constraints on photon mass and dark photon from the Jovian magnetic field
notes: Constraint on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon vs dark photon mass m_X from Jovian magnetic field (Juno MAG data). This is independent of dark photon relic density. The exclusion curve is only sparsely described in text: strongest bound eps<=2.8e-3 at m_X=2.0e-15 eV; at eps=1 the excluded band spans 3.2e-18 to 3.2e-14 eV; recent work gives eps<=0.13 at 1.1e-15 eV for comparison. Data points are approximate reconstructions of the exclusion contour (Fig.7) from textual anchors and should be treated as rough. Photon mass limit m_gamma < 2.5e-18 eV also reported but not a coupling. Note the paper's constraint is strongest between 3.2e-18 and 1.8e-15 eV; above 1.8e-15 eV COBE/FIRAS is stronger. | selector: text (sole candidate)
